notes.title: Below Sunshade 3.3 Release
notes.content:
Engine Fix: Resolved an RPG Maker MV engine issue that caused crashes and performance problems on monitors with refresh rates above 60Hz.
 New Passive Added: Explorer — Can now be obtained from the book located behind the Golem boss fight.
 Achievements Fixed:
    Secret Guardian Blade achievement now unlocks correctly.
    Achievement for helping Galan now triggers properly.
 Combat Fix: Resolved an issue where "On Attack" passives were not activating as intended.
 Balance Update: Increased Fire Ring's trigger chance from 10% to 15%. Buffed a few other items too.
 Map Update: The intro beach is now accessible only via the bottom-left exit of the camp map.
 Gallery Update: Added 6 previously missing scenes to the Gallery.

notes.title: Below Sunshade: Dreams of Fate
notes.content:
Hey folks!

Today we've released the final update for Below Sunshade! Dreams of Fate. 
We want to thank everyone who supported us along the way and we hope you enjoy the new Update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/4baec9359a0a7608c8609e7b121ebf6935bc0ffc.png

Overall we made Sunshade a lot easier with this Update. However the game will still be a small challenge if you intend to see all the content with one single playthrough. We've added two new Endings: One which allows you to join the Heart in her Corruption and the other one adds the option to leave the Island with Tulip and Galan. 

Unlike the previous two big updates, Dreams of Fate has no specific focus. its adding a bit of everything to the game while making changes to many existing systems and gameplay loops. Your feedback played a huge part in many of the changes.

Features

 Two new endings
 Gameplay and Combat reworked/rebalanced
 Lots of new Items to find and craft
 New Characters (Including sexy harpies)
 Ending and Mainstory reworked
 New Secrets and Puzzles
 New HUD elements such as the Relationship Window
 New Enemies 
 New Outfits 
 Lots of kinky new scenes
 Steam Achievements

notes.title: Below Sunshade - Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We're happy to announce the next and final chapter for Below Sunshade.

The Final Update will be released in Q4 2021 and of course free for everyone who owns the game as with our previous updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/c32bd1256652b5bbae9b7199f00208045ccb544d.png

What's to expect?

This update will mainly focus on two things: Fixing Bugs and adding content that has been highly requested by our players.

Here's a quick rundown of what exactly you can expect

 Tons of bugfixes
 New ways to customize your playstyle
 New Adult Scenes
 New Outfits for our favorite characters
 More Playerbase customization
 A new NPC who functions as follower and who will join you in battle

We hope you're as excited as we are for this update. Below Sunshade was our first game on steam. We've released two big content updates (Heart of the Island and Milestones) so far and we're confident that this final update will be a great addition for the game.

Until then?

There's still a few months left, so let us know in this thread what content and features you want to see! In the meantime we're also releasing our second title on Steam: Arenus. Which has been in developement for over four years now. We'll also try to contact steam to get discount codes for Arenus for everyone who bought Below Sunshade. 

Thank you all for your support and trust.

Stay tuned!

- Kaliyo

notes.title: Announcement - Below Sunshade: Milestones
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/5646795258a383fb8e5267704a2f6f90037f57e5.gif

Hey folks!

We are happy to announce ...

Below Sunshade: Milestones

Our next DLC for Below Sunshade and our largest one so far. Just like Heart of the Island, our new DLC will be free for all current and future owners of Below Sunshade.

I'll keep this post fairly short because Milestones will be released on the 10th November 2020 already.

What to expect


 New characters and storylines! 
We're aware that the first few days on the island are rather slow and that a lot of players felt lost in what to do. Our goal with this new DLC, besides improving the whole game, is to focus on adding content to its early game.

Milestone System!
Found a secret? Cleared a dungeon or completed a Quest? You'll now be rewarded with Milestone Points when doings so. You can spend those on special perks with the following three categories: Combat, Exploration and Crafting. This allows you to play the game even more like you want.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/5b9fb259c6aa219fdb012cc310e34b88dfcbb9a2.png

The Island revisited!
We've been making heavy changes to the whole gameflow to reduce grind and make the game overall a more smooth experience. This includes a lot of bugfixes and QoL changes! No more slow movement speed after loading the game, no more flickering busts during dialogues.

And more!
New Enemies, dungeons, locations to visit. New scenes with existing island inhabitants. New Items and weapons to craft and completly new gameplay features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/9ad5f24eab0bec0cbbcb02bf03b7b095f2ff7db6.png


We hope you are looking forward to this update!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Below Sunshade: Heart of the Island
notes.content:
Heart of the Island is our first free DLC for Below Sunshade. 
Our goal with this DLC was to connect story strings and turn Below Sunshade into a more compelling game to play through overall. We hope you enjoy the new content.

New Features

The Heart
A new Location featuring a new character. The heart features a whole new storyline with two possible paths to chose from. A path of light and a path of corruption.

The Heart is voiced by the fantastic Bordeaux Black

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/b65fb3c06e743009d4c3bd1a3c16f0f5558beb58.png

New Dialogue Features
Idrune, Talitha and all other characters now breath and blink during conversations.
We've added this feature to provide more immersive dialogues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/cb81c51ae660cd40f9c327cb1eb64499721ac4b9.png

Living Orbs
Those orbs are the remains of a forgotten civilization. 
Find them and they will support you in battle.

New Enemies
A few new enemies have been added to the Island: From corrupted boars to a dangerous naga.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/98c852bc1321fa2adcbfd3ee01c027b50ee5383b.png

CG Gallery
You're now able to view unlocked CG Pictures in the new gallery.
We'll expand on the gallery in the future.

And more...
We've fixed bugs, rebalanced aspects of the game and of course added a few new items.
You're also able to give Idrune a task per day. For example you can ask her now to gather some branches for you.

Thank you for your support and stay tuned.
We're aware that the first few days of Sunshade would do well with some new content. ;)

notes.title: State of the Game
notes.content:
New Faces

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/7f9744bfbed309dc0eeebc3812dd467b6ededde3.png

Talitha has been on the island long before you arrived. The Vampiric pirate has spent many years on her own, avoiding the ire of the local population, while simultaneously feeding on their blood to survive.

The unorthodox manner of her arrival on the island, not to mention her knowledge of its inhabitants, may provide the key that you need to escape.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/a52d248f434c47c4f75c1936dae026b0750d1b6b.png

Naipei is one of the mysterious Sirens that can often be found on islands in the warmer Oceans of Adorevia. Like all of her kind, she will grant sailors blessing and aid in exchange for gifts. 
But unlike others of her kind, Naipei is not on the island seeking boons. She is on the island for a more impassioned and violent purpose. Perhaps the two of you can find mutual cause? 
     
Survival & Needs

When you add survival aspects into your game it's all about the right balance. It should never feel tedious and like a grind, instead it should be an element that plays along with the rest of the game. 

Instead the game offers a wide mix of various, smaller features that all together create  fun and flexible gameplay.  You want to spend the new day gathering resources for a new building but you and Idrune are hungry? You can wait till night and hunt more dangerous creatures for better quality food or you split the resource hunt onto two days and play safe. 

The game offers several approaches so you can chose the path you want.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/f37e8e0a0f0cabfdac55a56d1edd9006fd620fc0.png

And all those decisions eventually result in one of five endings, so the game offers replayability and rewards exploration and experimenting. 

Exploration is one of the game's pillars together with survival and story. Secrets and exploration are a natural connection with the setting of being stranded on a mysterious island. 

So there are secrets everywhere, some easy to find and some which may never be found at all.
